column1: # harnesses.tsv: what each harness gives Shipinetics. Read by `shipinetics status`.
# Columns (tab-separated): harness, check, today, planned, note
#   check:   secrets (secrets guard), edits (edit guard), pr (PR gate), installs (install gate),
#            verify (quick verify after a commit), compact (docs before /compact), notice
#            (session-start notice), worktrees (worktree notice), shims (short commands), usage (token log)
#   today:   enforced (a guard or gate refuses the action), works (a check that only informs runs),
#            instruction (the skills say it, nothing stops the agent), partial, or not-yet (no adapter
#   planned: what the adapter can reach, from docs/research/harnesses.md (checked 2026-11-22)
# Lines that start with # are comments.
